local self=require('openmw.self')
local types=require('openmw.types')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local t=.2
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 t=t+dt;if t<.2 then return end;t=0
 assert(not types.Actor.isDead(self),'Player died during original unarmed course')
 local target=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x6c927));assert(target and target:isValid(),'Original Mudcrab missing')
 print('BlockUse sample base='..types.NPC.stats.skills.block(self).base..' xp='..types.NPC.stats.skills.block(self).progress..' health='..types.Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current)
 local item=types.Actor.getEquipment(self,types.Actor.EQUIPMENT_SLOT.CarriedRight)
 print('VilverinContinue AxeContact sample health='..types.Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current..' enemy='..types.Actor.stats.dynamic.health(target).current..' distance='..(target.position-self.position):length()..' hand='..types.NPC.stats.skills.handtohand(self).base..' xp='..types.NPC.stats.skills.handtohand(self).progress..' weapon='..(item and item.recordId or 'none')..' stance='..tostring(types.Actor.getStance(self)))
 if types.Actor.stats.dynamic.health(target).current<9.99 then print('VilverinContinue AxeContact contact hurt') end
 if item then print('VilverinContinue AxeContact equipped weapon');if types.Actor.getStance(self)==types.Actor.STANCE.Weapon then print('VilverinContinue AxeContact readied') end end
 if (target.position-self.position):length()<80 then print('VilverinContinue AxeContact in reach') end
 local aim=target:getBoundingBox().center;local p=camera.getViewTransform():apply(aim);local yaw=math.atan2(p.x,-p.z);local pitch=-math.atan2(p.y,math.sqrt(p.x*p.x+p.z*p.z))
 print(string.format('VilverinContinue AxeContact aim x=%d y=%d',math.max(-150,math.min(150,math.floor(yaw*256+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(pitch*256+.5)))))
 if math.abs(yaw)<.02 and math.abs(pitch)<.02 then print('VilverinContinue AxeContact facing') end
end}}}}
